title: Frozen Trail is coming October 8!
body:
# Frozen Trail arrives October 8!

**Hello Raiders, this is Embark speaking.**

October is approaching, and with it the Frozen Trail update. We wanted to pause and share what's been happening on our end since we last explained how updates would change going forward.

Back in May, we announced a shift toward fewer but bigger updates. We recognize this results in longer gaps between major releases, and we're grateful to everyone who has stayed with us as we kept delivering new content in the meantime, including projects, events, a new Trader, and continuous improvements based on player feedback.

Behind closed doors, our attention has been squarely on Frozen Trail. This will be the largest update since the game launched, built specifically to answer some of the bigger questions the community has raised. Almost every corner of the game has been touched by lessons learned over recent months. Below is a preview of what we've been building.

## **The Next Frontier**

The centerpiece of Frozen Trail is a brand new map. Shani will send Raiders out to investigate a signal of unprecedented strength coming from beyond the mountains. Something significant has taken place there, and no Raider would want to miss out on joining the first scouting team.

You'll explore a bitterly cold, frozen settlement tucked beneath towering peaks at the edge of the Rust Belt. This area once held thriving villages, factories, research facilities, and an observatory, all long since abandoned.

Constructing this new map has pushed our level design team into new and exciting territory. Our goal was an ambitious space with more verticality, more room for exploration, and more chances for discovery. Expect danger both above ground and beneath it, along with environments unlike anything Raiders have encountered so far.

We've just wrapped up a round of user experience research testing, and the team is now refining the map to make sure it delivers maximum excitement.

## **New High-level Challenge**

Frozen Trail will also bring a massive new ARC Operation aimed at seasoned Raiders hungry to test their limits further.

Without revealing too much, this new activity centers on concepts that have grown more and more important to us during development: consequential decisions, dynamic encounters, and moments requiring teamwork and sharp judgment.

Victory won't be simple. You'll need to juggle combat, cooperation, risk, and survival in what we consider one of the most demanding experiences ARC Raiders has produced so far, one that pays off for those brave enough to take it on.

We're holding back further details for the full reveal, but we're eager for you to try it firsthand.

## **New ARC, New Threats**

Our team has been busy crafting new ARC threats that will launch alongside the new map, each one built to disrupt the habits you've developed around moving, fighting, and adapting. These new ARC enemies span the range from a small, agile troublemaker to a massive machine capable of stopping you cold.

Designing new ARC enemies is one of the more complex parts of development. Starting from early concepts and animation through to behavior systems and machine learning that give them their unique "spark of life," each enemy takes months of refinement before it's ready. We believe the wait will be worthwhile, and we're eager to hear your reactions.

## **Deepening Progression**

Frozen Trail is also reshaping what it means to be a Raider.

One insight that keeps shaping our approach is that the most satisfying raids come from meaningful choices. This has guided how we're building progression throughout Frozen Trail, giving you room to develop a deeper sense of identity within the Rust Belt.

Your Raider Den has served its purpose well, but expansion time has come. We're constructing deeper progression systems that let players chart their own path and work toward long-term goals.

This is why your Raider will gain access to a new space called the Outpost. After months spent on the defensive, hiding below ground, it's time to push back against ARC. You'll be able to decorate your Outpost, research new aspects of the world, and take the first steps toward reclaiming the surface.

Beyond Outposts, we're also reworking the Skill Tree to give players greater control over the type of Raider they want to become. Raider Decks are getting attention too, with efforts focused on making them more engaging and rewarding to use.

## **And More…**

These represent only a portion of what's arriving with Frozen Trail.

The team continues developing additional content to enrich your experience, including new weapons (and new customization options for them), gadgets, cosmetics, instruments, and various other surprises we'll reveal as launch approaches.

Alongside these additions, we'll keep refining the core ARC Raiders experience through continued work on matchmaking, anti-cheat systems, stability, and quality-of-life updates. These changes might not always grab headlines, but they remain essential to keeping every raid feeling fair and enjoyable.

Frozen Trail launches on October 8, and we'll be sharing additional details throughout September.

Until then, if you're attending gamescom in Cologne, come find us! We'd love the chance to meet you and watch you experience ARC Raiders in person.

See you topside,

Aleksander Grøndal

Executive Producer
